text.doc.css: Styles the rendered Markdown: headings, code, tables, the page header and the not-found page
text.highlight.css: Colours code tokens from the theme palette in both light and dark
text.layout.css: Lays out the docs site: sticky sidebar with the pulsing lantern mark on desktop, collapsing menu on a phone, pager, footer legal lines, focus and skip link
text.tokens.css: Holds the pulse period, the font families, the spacing measures and the light and dark theme colours of the Blueprint look
